Orderly evening a few notes for anyone with a companion animal
Please read this before you travel

Pet Travel Notice

Travelers need to check animal fit, carrier setup, and paperwork before they come to Aurelia Skyways. Keep your pet calm, secure, and ready for routine desk review when you reach the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Staff will look over service changes, special handling notes, and any alerts in the desk ledger. If something is unclear, the case moves through a calm stepwise review so the team can sort it out without fuss. That helps avoid delays at the skyport and keeps the trip steady for everyone involved.

Please bring your animal to the desk with the carrier closed and the leash or restraint in place if needed. Follow the instructions from the desk team at once, and do not separate from your pet unless staff asks you to.

For help with check-in, carrier checks, or a simple change to your travel plan, speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
